The deployed Vercel dashboard is configured as a deterministic demo; the live OIDC/API mode is implemented but not activated in the deployment.
GitHub App, OSV enrichment, signed-receipt, and distributed-rate-limit primitives are not live-connected to the deployed demo.
The browser E2E suite verifies the deterministic dashboard; no live API/OIDC browser E2E is claimed until owner infrastructure is configured.
No production OIDC provider has been configured in the current environment.
No Neon connection strings have been injected into the deployment.
No Azure Container Apps API or scheduled worker resource has been created.
The API now uses route- and verified-identity-aware per-instance limiting by default; a Redis-compatible distributed adapter exists but is not selected or connected.
Secret scanning uses high-confidence patterns and does not provide entropy analysis.
The PostgreSQL polling queue is not a benchmarked high-throughput distributed queue.
The gateway creates dedicated AgentApproval rows for REQUIRE_APPROVAL actions; live identity/provider deployment and operational review remain unconfigured.
The API scan lifecycle now persists advisory summaries and receipt digests, but live external-provider, signing-custody, and deployed-worker evidence is absent.
